title: Lightweight Spectral Subspace Filtering for Trojan-Resilient AI Inference Engines
abstract: arXiv:2611.29734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a significant security threat to deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on AI inference engines and hardware accelerators. By embedding hidden triggers during training, these attacks induce malicious behavior while maintaining high accuracy on benign inputs. Multi-trigger backdoor attacks are particularly challenging to detect and mitigate because of the distributed and stealthy nature of their effects. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a training-free Spectral Subspace Filtering framework that detects and suppresses backdoor-induced activations by analyzing latent feature representations. Exploiting the geometric separation between benign and malicious feature distributions, the framework employs Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to identify the dominant malicious subspace and performs inference-time spectral scrubbing through activation projection. translated_title: 面向木马弹性AI推理引擎的轻量级谱子空间滤波
translated_abstract: 后门攻击对部署在AI推理引擎和硬件加速器上的深度神经网络（DNN）构成了重大安全威胁。这类攻击通过在训练过程中嵌入隐藏触发器，在保持对良性输入高准确率的同时诱导恶意行为。多触发器后门攻击由于其影响具有分布式和隐蔽性，尤其难以检测和缓解。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种无需训练的谱子空间滤波框架，通过分析潜在特征表示来检测和抑制后门引发的激活。该框架利用良性特征分布与恶意特征分布之间的几何分离特性，采用奇异值分解（SVD）识别主导的恶意子空间，并通过激活投影在推理阶段执行谱净化。该方法无需修改模型即可抑制后门效应。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的轻量级谱子空间滤波框架，利用SVD识别恶意特征子空间并通过激活投影在推理时检测和抑制深度神经网络中的多触发器后门攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free lightweight Spectral Subspace Filtering framework that leverages SVD to identify malicious feature subspaces and suppresses multi-trigger backdoor attacks in DNNs at inference time through activation projection.
